note: customer-data erasure, the loan register and work sessions, with their routes

areas.name: privacy
areas.doc: Customer-data erasure: the scrubber, the keys and matching that decide what belongs to one person, the sweep, shop and customer redaction, the requests held for an admin, and the privacy log. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes (the privacy settings and Shopify's privacy webhook) are in gizmo/routes/privacy.py. Read as `privacy.NAME`.

areas.name: loans
areas.doc: Loan units: the projectors that go out to customers, and where they are. The register and its copy in memory, the board. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its route is in gizmo/routes/loans.py. Read as `loans.NAME`.

areas.name: work
areas.doc: Work sessions: clocking in and out, for part-time accounts. The sessions store and its copy in memory, who is monitored, the open session. Moved out of copilot.py (stage 4 of the 14 October audit); its routes are in gizmo/routes/work.py. Read as `work.NAME`.

routes.name: routes_privacy
routes.doc: The privacy routes: the privacy settings, and Shopify's privacy webhook (data requests and redactions). Gathered from add_routes (stage 4 of the 14 October audit) where the first stood; their paths are literal, so no request changes hands.
routes.register_doc: Add the privacy routes to the app.
routes.comment: The privacy routes (gizmo/routes/privacy.py), gathered where the first stood.
